description.zh: 每个进程看到自己从 0 开始的地址空间；连续分配会留下外部碎片，按页分配不需要连续。在一个首次适配分配器上比较两者拒绝了多少进程。
description.en: Each process sees its own address space starting at 0; contiguous allocation leaves external fragmentation, paging needs no contiguity. A first-fit allocator and a paged one compared on the same arrivals.

title.en: Pages, offsets and multi-level page tables

description.zh: 地址切成页号和页内偏移；平铺的页表在 48 位地址下要 512 GiB，所以表本身也分页，做成多级的树。
description.en: An address splits into a page number and an offset; a flat table for 48-bit addresses would need 512 GiB, so the table is paged too and becomes a multi-level tree.

title.zh: x86-64 四级页表逐位走一遍
title.en: An x86-64 four-level page walk, bit by bit

description.zh: 按 Intel 手册第 5 章，48 位地址切成四个 9 位下标和 12 位偏移，依次读 PML4、PDPT、PD、PT；页表项每一位的意思，规范地址和五级分页。
description.en: Following chapter 5 of Intel's manual, a 48-bit address splits into four 9-bit indices and a 12-bit offset read through PML4, PDPT, PD and PT; what each bit of an entry means, canonical addresses and five-level paging.

description.zh: TLB 记住最近的翻译；它管得住的内存是项数乘页大小。在随机读、顺序扫和沿列走三种访问上看缺失率。
description.en: The TLB remembers recent translations; the memory it covers is entries times page size. Miss rates for random reads, a sequential sweep and a column walk.

title.zh: 一次 TLB 缺失要付多少

description.zh: 缺失时硬件遍历器去读页表；页表遍历缓存记住上几级的表项，常常只剩最后一次读。用 Zen 5 的两级 TLB 估算每次访问的周期范围。
description.en: On a miss a hardware walker reads the page tables; a page-walk cache keeps the upper levels so often only the last read is left. Cycles per access bracketed with Zen 5's two TLB levels.

zh: 页表遍历要读几次内存
en: how many memory reads per page walk

description.zh: 一项映射 2 MiB 或 1 GiB，TLB 覆盖范围大几百倍、遍历少一两级；代价是稀疏使用时多占内存，且需要连续的物理内存。
description.en: One entry maps 2 MiB or 1 GiB, multiplying TLB reach by hundreds and shortening the walk; the price is wasted memory when use is sparse and the need for contiguous physical memory.

description.zh: 表项无效时 CPU 交给操作系统；次要缺页不到一微秒，从固态硬盘读几十微秒，从机械硬盘十几毫秒。有效访问时间公式说明缺页率要多低；工作集放不进内存就会抖动。
description.en: An invalid entry hands control to the operating system; a minor fault takes under a microsecond, a read from an SSD tens of microseconds, from a hard disk over ten milliseconds. The effective-access-time formula shows how rare faults must be; a working set that does not fit makes the machine thrash.

zh: 次要缺页 主要缺页

description.zh: FIFO、LRU、时钟算法和 OPT 在同一串引用上比较；FIFO 多给页框反而可能缺页更多（Belady 异常），栈算法不会。
description.en: FIFO, LRU, the clock algorithm and OPT compared on the same reference string; FIFO can fault more with more frames (Belady's anomaly), stack algorithms cannot.

description.zh: fork 之后父子进程共用全部页框、都标成只读；第一次写才复制那一页。映射文件也走同一条缺页路径。
description.en: After fork, parent and child share every frame read-only; a page is copied only on its first write. Memory-mapped files take the same page-fault path.

description.zh: 换进程要换页表；给 TLB 项打上进程标签（PCID）就不必清空。Meltdown 之后 KPTI 每次进出内核都换一次 CR3，有没有 PCID 差别很大。
description.en: A context switch changes page tables; tagging TLB entries with a process ID (PCID) avoids flushing. After Meltdown, KPTI switches CR3 on every kernel entry and exit, and PCID makes the difference.

zh: 进程切换 TLB 刷新

title.en: Two-dimensional page walks in virtual machines

description.zh: 客户机的每个表指针还要经宿主机的页表翻译：四级套四级最多读 24 次。大页和遍历缓存在这里更要紧；IOMMU 给设备的也是一套页表。
description.en: Every guest table pointer is itself translated through the host's tables: up to 24 reads for four levels on four. Huge pages and walk caches matter even more here; the IOMMU is a page table for devices.

title.zh: 虚拟内存的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 五级分页在 Linux 上无条件编进内核，Arm 与苹果的 16 KiB 页，安卓要求应用支持 16 KB 页，CXL 内存成为换页前的新一层。
description.en: Five-level paging built unconditionally into Linux, 16 KiB pages on Arm and Apple, Android requiring apps to support 16 KB pages, and CXL memory as a new tier before swap.

title.zh: 程序慢的时候问三件事
title.en: Three questions when a program is slow

description.zh: 工作集有多少页、缺页是哪一种、翻译要套几层。
description.en: How many pages the working set spans, which kind of page fault it takes, and how many layers of translation it goes through.

label.en: Cut into pages, looked up in a table

reason.zh: 第 2 章用第 1 章分页分配器的页，引出要多大的页表和为什么要分级。
reason.en: Chapter 2 takes the pages of chapter 1’s paging allocator and asks how big the table is and why it is a tree.

reason.zh: 第 3 章把第 2 章的多级页表落到 x86-64 的四级页表和逐位拆分上。
reason.en: Chapter 3 turns chapter 2’s multi-level table into x86-64’s four levels and their bit fields.

reason.zh: 第 4 章的 TLB 存的是第 3 章那次页表遍历的结果，命中就不用再走。
reason.en: Chapter 4’s TLB stores the result of chapter 3’s walk, so a hit skips it.

reason.zh: 第 5 章算的是第 4 章的 TLB 没命中时，再走一遍页表要读几次内存。
reason.en: Chapter 5 counts the memory reads of a walk when chapter 4’s TLB misses.

reason.zh: 第 6 章的大页让第 4 章的每个 TLB 项覆盖 2 MiB 或 1 GiB，覆盖范围成百倍增加。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s huge pages let each of chapter 4’s TLB entries cover 2 MiB or 1 GiB, multiplying its reach.

reason.zh: 第 6 章用同一个模型说明大页还让第 5 章的页表遍历少走一级或两级。
reason.en: Chapter 6 uses the same model to show huge pages also cut one or two levels from chapter 5’s walk.

label.en: Memory is full: whom to evict

reason.zh: 第 8 章的置换算法决定第 7 章的缺页把哪一页换出去。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s algorithms decide which page chapter 7’s faults push out.

reason.zh: 第 11 章的二维页表遍历是把第 3 章的四级遍历套在另一套四级遍历里，(n+1)(m+1) − 1 次读。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s two-dimensional walk nests chapter 3’s four-level walk inside another, (n+1)(m+1) − 1 reads.

label.zh: 换进程时 TLB 怎么办
label.en: What the TLB does on a switch

reason.zh: 第 10 章讲第 4 章的 TLB 在进程切换、进出内核时要不要清空，PCID 和 KPTI 都是这个问题。
reason.en: Chapter 10 asks whether chapter 4’s TLB must be flushed on a process switch or a kernel entry; PCID and KPTI are both that question.

label.zh: TLB 和 L1 同时查
label.en: TLB and L1 looked up together

reason.zh: 《CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的》第 7 章的 VIPT 靠的是 TLB 翻译高位时 L1 已用页内偏移选组；第 7 章链接本篇第 4 章讲 TLB。
reason.en: VIPT in chapter 7 of “How a CPU’s Three Levels of Cache Work” relies on L1 choosing the set from the page offset while the TLB translates; that chapter links chapter 4 here for the TLB.

label.zh: 同一个局部性多了一层
label.en: The same locality, one level up

reason.zh: 第 4 章说按行访问对 TLB 好的理由和《为什么计算一直在等内存》第 2 章对缓存的一样，只是单位从缓存行变成页。
reason.en: Chapter 4 says row-order access suits the TLB for the reason chapter 2 of “Why Compute Waits for Memory” gives for caches, with pages instead of lines.

reason.zh: 第 5 章指出页表遍历和《CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的》第 10 章的追指针一样，延迟一级一级叠起来。
reason.en: Chapter 5 points out a page walk is the pointer chase of chapter 10 of “How a CPU’s Three Levels of Cache Work”, latencies adding up level by level.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的五页循环让 LRU 次次缺页，和《CPU 的三级缓存是怎么工作的》第 4 章里比缓存大一点的循环一样。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s five-page loop makes LRU miss every time, like the slightly-too-big loop in chapter 4 of “How a CPU’s Three Levels of Cache Work”.

label.zh: 主要缺页的代价取决于磁盘
label.en: A major fault costs a disk read

reason.zh: 第 7 章的主要缺页一次要几十微秒到几毫秒，数字来自《硬盘里到底是什么》第 8 章讲的固态和机械硬盘延迟。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s major faults cost tens of microseconds to milliseconds, the SSD and HDD latencies of chapter 8 of “What a Drive Is Made Of”.

reason.zh: 第 11 章最后一段说 IOMMU 用一套给设备的页表翻译 DMA 地址，它挡住和漏掉的在《雷电接口是怎么工作的》第 8 章。
reason.en: Chapter 11’s last paragraph says the IOMMU translates DMA addresses with page tables for devices; what it blocks and misses is chapter 8 of “How Thunderbolt Works”.

label.en: Devices read and write memory directly

reason.zh: 第 11 章说网卡和固态硬盘用《PCIe 为什么能一代一代翻倍》第 7 章的 DMA 读写内存，地址要先经 IOMMU 翻译。
reason.en: Chapter 11 says NICs and SSDs use the DMA of chapter 7 of “Why PCIe Keeps Doubling”, with addresses translated by the IOMMU first.
